newsitem.title: USA: NYCE cotton down at midsession in slow trading.
newsitem.headline: NYCE cotton down at midsession in slow trading.

text.p: NYCE cotton futures were modestly lower at midsession amid lackluster activity, analysts said.
"We have had no fundamentals to trade with and the market is marking time till the Aug 12 USDA supply and demand report and production estimates," an analyst said. "The market is waiting for that."
At 1145 EDT, December was down 0.31 cent at 74.74 cents a lb, traded 75.10 to 74.60 cents. The rest were 0.07 cent firmer to 0.31 cent lower.
